description: This file defines theme-related functions for a frontend project, including a base theme object with color and typography tokens, and functions for generating categorical color palettes and category-to-color mappings. It provides styling utilities for a section of a web application.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens including colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Generates a deterministic palette of colors suitable for categorically distinct series, seeded by the theme's colors, with extension capabilities for more categories.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Creates a mapping from category names to colors, ensuring consistent color assignment across categories.
